channels.query_used: How does a maintenance window get released, and who has to sign it?
How does a maintenance window get released, and who has to sign it? release signature approval
How does a maintenance window get released, and who has to sign it? release signature approval

channels.answer: A maintenance window is released by the change advisory board, which meets weekly and rates every submitted change by risk, reach and rollback plan. Two signatures are required and neither is optional: the operations owner signs for the platform, and the responsible engineer signs for the change itself. With only one of the two the window stays in submitted and no work may start.

citations.title: Operations handbook, section 7 — maintenance and releases
citations.snippet: A maintenance window is released by the change advisory board, which sits every Tuesday and rates each submitted change by risk, reach and rollback plan. A window counts as released only once the operations owner and the responsible engineer have both signed; with one signature it stays submitted.
